description: P-N junction electrical model: Isc(t), Voc(T), fill-factor, T-dependent Voc, isotope decay P(t)=P0*exp(-lambda*t)

unit.name: Ni-63 betavoltaic cell with diamond p-n junction (temperature-dependent electrical model)
unit.source: Olsen et al. (1993) Nucl. Instrum. Methods B 73; Sychov et al. (2008) Appl. Radiat. Isot. 66; Prelas et al. (2014) Progress in Nuclear Energy 75; Sun et al. (2018) Appl. Energy 225

E_beta_MeV.note: Mean beta energy for Ni-63 ~17 keV

Voc_ref_V.note: Open-circuit voltage at T_ref and t=0 (diamond beta cell ~1.5-3V)

dVoc_dT_mV_K.note: Temperature coefficient of Voc (negative, like PV cells, ~-2 to -3 mV/K)

fill_factor_0.note: Fill factor at t=0 (beta cell FF typically 0.6-0.75)

fill_factor_decay_rate.note: FF degradation rate due to radiation damage (small for Ni-63)

Isc_ref_uA.note: Short-circuit current at T_ref and t=0 (0.1 Ci Ni-63 ~0.3-0.8 uA)
